 ATP Stockholm Day 2 Predictions Including Ugo Humbert vs Adolfo Daniel Vallejo 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 Six first-round matches are scheduled on Day 2 of the Stockholm Open held in Sweden. This article features seventh seed Ugo Humbert, who will face Paraguay’s Adolfo Daniel Vallejo. As always, we at LWOT will offer predictions for every match on the slate, but which players will advance?
 ATP Stockholm Day 2 Predictions
 Cameron Norrie vs James Duckworth
 Head-to-Head : Norrie 1-0 Duckworth
 Former World No. 8 Cameron Norrie has struggled for form, winning just 3 of his last 10 matches in all competitions. This is his third main-draw appearance in Stockholm, and he will look to make a deep run here and end his ATP season on a high. James Duckworth reached the quarterfinals in Almaty last month, but outside of that, he hasn’t won a match in the last three months. Norrie has already defeated Duckworth this season, and I expect another straight-sets win for the Brit.
 Prediction: Norrie in 2 
 Tomas Martin Etcheverry vs Max Dahlin
 Head-to-Head : first meeting
 Tomas Martin Etcheverry ended his six-match losing streak at the Paris Masters last week, defeating Andrey Rublev and Alex de Minaur. He lost a close match to Rinky Hijikata in the third round, but must be pleased with his improved level. He will look to carry the momentum and get off to a solid start here. Qualifier Max Dahlin is ranked #772 and has never won a tour-level match. This would be a learning experience for the Swedish player, but a win seems unlikely.
 Prediction: Etcheverry in 2 
 Ugo Humbert vs Adolfo Daniel Vallejo
 Head-to-Head : first meeting
 Aug 2, 2026; Montreal, Qc, Canada; Adolfo Daniel Vallejo (PAR) hits a backhand against Juncheng Shang (CHN) during first round play at IGA Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Eric Bolte-Imagn Images 
 Indoor hard courts are Ugo Humbert’s most successful surface, but he has won just one match from three tournaments during this swing and will look to improve this week. He is the reigning finalist here and needs a strong start to regain some confidence. Adolfo Daniel Vallejo has performed well this season, but he has limited experience on this surface. Humbert should take advantage.
 Prediction: Humbert in 3
